name: nfc_music
description: Play music on Volumio by scanning NFC tags with a PC/SC reader (e.g. ACR122U).

scripts.test: node --check index.js && for f in lib/*.js; do node --check "$f"; done

author: LinkeLoutje

volumio_info.details: Link NFC tags to albums, tracks or playlists from your music library. Hold a tag against the reader and Volumio starts playing. Tags are configured on the plugin settings page: scan a tag, give it a name and choose what it should play. Supports PC/SC readers such as the ACR122U; the required pcscd service is installed automatically.
volumio_info.changelog: Tags are now stored in /data/configuration and survive plugin updates; install.sh installs pcscd.
